product_constraint: 50%-200% real API committed Decode acceleration, d2/d3, exact state/logits/output, joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total

downward_budget.scope: Opportunity ceiling, not a prediction or current stall attribution; cannot assume every barrier is exposed.

mechanism: Merge duplicate per-iteration CTA rendezvous in private MTP QK and PV rings. Original async groups, slots, data and numerical operations remain unchanged.
equivalence_ledger: Iteration i stages i+3 in a distinct slot; current consumer reads slot i.
Every thread finishes its current reads before executing its per-thread wait and the retained CTA barrier.
The retained barrier therefore retires all current readers and publishes waited copies before iteration i+1 can stage i+4 into old slot i.
Tail wait counts and all arithmetic/causal predicates remain unchanged; no buffer, launch, state or allocation change.
reference_translation: Existing FlashInfer-derived cp.async ring, preserving source license and original scalar semantics; change only the redundant rendezvous boundary. Prior direct-PV and shared-row PV variants changed ownership and are not reopened.
gates: full P513 transactions and all M2/3/4 prefix state/logits; P8192 prefix-only
immediate d2 P65/8K/40K API vs v52; >3% slowdown stops, neutral removes, useful unlocks d3
expiry: Useful result dependency-only through next complete verifier API return or archival; no production promotion or barrier/tile scan.

direction_retention_screen.scope: Pragmatic direction threshold to avoid retaining neutral sub-percent changes, not noise qualification.
